description: Use to get proof of a completed trade: a signed receipt for a settled deal (buyer, seller, token, amounts, fee) that anyone can re-check onchain. Public. Fails with not_settled for deals that are still open.

chain.description: robinhood (default), base, elysium or solana. Pass the chain the deal was settled on.

escrow.description: Optional: the escrow contract the deal lives on, as listed in bull_stats recent[].escrow. Needed only for a deal on an earlier (retired) escrow: deal numbers restart at 1 on every escrow. Default: the current escrow.

name: bull_get_receipt
